meta.parties: Chelliah Et Al. v. Sinnatamby Et Al

rules.statement: When one of two spouses dies, the entirety of their common estate vests in the administrator of such deceased spouse for purposes of administration.
rules.supporting_quote: "I take it under the pure Roman-Dutch law half of the chose-in-action would vest immediately in the wife. She could sue for and give a discharge in respect of her half share of the debt, though she would no doubt be accountable to any creditor of the estate.... But this position is modified in two ways: firstly, by a series of cases culminating in the decision of the Full Court in Cantlay v. Elkington 1. It was there held that when one of two spouses died, married in community, the entirety of the common estate vests in the administrator of such deceased spouse for purposes of administration...."
